items.evidence: Log shows 5 uL master mix into all 96 wells first, then 4 uL primer pair, then 1 uL colony template (10 uL reaction, MM before template), matching the paper's OT-2 volume.
Log shows primer_plate and colony_plate well X going to the same pcr_plate well X for all 96 wells (A1..H12), each once.
Master mix uses one tip dispensed from well top into empty wells; each primer and each template step has its own pick up/drop tip; the final log line is a drop tip.
Comments record sealing and a program of 98 C 2 min, 30 cycles of 98 C 10 s/~55-65 C 30 s/72 C 30 s, final 72 C 2 min, 4 C hold, suitable for Q5.

The comment assumes primer stock is 2.5x, an invented assumption. The 3x mix-in-well after template adds mixing steps, and the 'blow_out' at the well top and annealing temperature stay vague ('~55-65 C'), so the adaptation is not fully sound or specified.

judge.summary: The protocol performs the reaction setup correctly: 5 uL Q5 mix, 4 uL primer pair and 1 uL colony template per well, in that order, with correct well-to-well mapping, fresh tips and a recorded Q5 thermocycling program. Fidelity fails because the primer-stock concentration is an invented assumption and the annealing temperature is left as a range.
